keyFindings.description:
A typed block indented inside a quote or list item, ending the document in a whitespace-only line with no line feed, reads otherwise than the browser engine: the typed block strips no indentation from that line (offset == len(line)), so codeColumns keeps directive.indent extra columns. Reproduced at 8586a04f: '>   :::callout{}
>       code
>         ' Go code
    / engine code
   (main code); '- a

    :::callout{}
          code
            ' Go '  code
      ' / engine '  code
    '; '>   :::callout{}
>   ~~~
>   x
>   ' Go x
   / engine x. With a final line feed all agree. Fix: drop '&& offset < len(line)' (the deep reviewer's scratch run: all 9 rows agree, 0 regressions over 7,960 documents); add the rows to TestIndentedCodeKeeps... and TestFencedCode...; a generator kind with a typed block indented in its container.

heldOpenBefore restates refusals.go:66-73's predicate; the 'no document stored today is newly refused' guarantee depends on the two staying equal, and nothing ties them. Make refusals.go use the helper (e.g. heldOpenBy returning the List or Blockquote so the two messages stay).
The readers table, check closure, reader loop and engine subtest are copied line for line from indented_code_test.go:53-102; one shared helper beside readCodeAndSpread.

Changelog fragment and packages/envoy/AGENTS.md do not say that a last line with no line feed keeps the columns its containers leave of a tab (lastLineColumns: '> ```
> x
>	' x -> x
  ), nor the fenced no-line-feed drop in the fragment; prose coupled to the directive.go fix, so named rather than fixed by the reviewer.
codeColumns' doc cites interruptsOpenBlock for the held-open rule; Close decides it through heldOpenBefore (or its renamed successor).
holdCodeLines returns the held set and also writes blankAfterAttr=false on the next block; name or split it so browserListSpacing shows that it changes the tree.
